subject: Post-call recap: pricing, token volumes, and burst / overage terms
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: pricing, token volumes, and burst / overage terms

Sara — great to meet earlier. Quick recap of what we agreed on during the call and proposed next steps so we can get a pilot in place quickly.

Summary of requirements you shared:
- Typical monthly baseline: ~15M tokens (generation + small prompt tokens).
- Peak events: occasional spikes up to ~60–80M tokens over a 24-hour window tied to product launches / marketing sends.
- Latency SLO: 95% < 300ms for single-turn inference; some endpoints can tolerate 500–800ms for large-context requests.
- Security: will need SOC2 + audit log access; we can enable Private deployment later if required.

Initial pricing thoughts (ballpark):
- Committed baseline: 15M tokens / month at $12 per 1M tokens (pilot tier).
- Burst policy: allow short-lived bursts up to 4x baseline sustained for up to 30 minutes before auto-throttling. Bursts debit from a burst bucket (separately metered) during the month.
- Overage: after committed + burst bucket are exhausted, overage billed at $18 per 1M tokens (1.5x the pilot unit).
- Volume discount: deeper discounts (target $8–10 per 1M) available with a 6–12 month committed capacity / higher minimum spend.

Clarification request from us to you (helps finalize SOW & pricing):
1) Can you share 90/95/99th percentile hourly token rates for the last 3 months (CSV ok)?
2) Confirm whether the marketing launches are predictable windows (dates) or ad-hoc. If predictable, we can pre-authorize larger temporary quotas to avoid throttling.
3) Preferred procurement terms / PO cadence?

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll circulate a short SOW + pricing sheet (attached) with two options: Pilot (3 months, low commitment) and Commit (6–12 months with deeper discounts).
- If you confirm the 90/95/99 token numbers we’ll map a burst bucket size and explicit burst SLA.
- Aim to start pilot the week of Aug 17 if paperwork is approved — proposed kickoff + traffic simulator run.

Attached: pricing_sheet-v2.pdf (line items + sample billing scenarios), sow-draft-nimbus.docx (pilot & commit options).

Thanks — appreciate the time.

—
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Sara Lim <sara@nimbus.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nimbus Analytics Billing <billing@nimbus.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 17:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: pricing, token volumes, and burst / overage terms

Thanks Dylan — helpful recap. A few items to clarify from our side before we escalate to procurement: 

1) Budget: our current target for a pilot is closer to $10 / 1M tokens (we do understand discounts at scale). Is there flexibility to get the pilot to $10-11 if we lock a minimum spend for 3 months?

2) Burst accounting: critically — will burst usage be deducted from the committed baseline first, or will it be billed as a separate burst bucket / overage? We need to avoid surprise billing during launches.

3) SLA: during bursts we need predictable behavior — either automatic increase of capacity for a short window (we absorb cost) or a hard throttle that we can program around. Which option do you recommend for a pilot?

4) PO terms: net45 is our default. Can Redwood accept net30 for pilots, or can we arrange prepayment for the pilot term?

If you can reply with a short written option (pilot at $10–11 with clear burst accounting) we can pull procurement in.

Best,
Sara
Head of Product | Nimbus Analytics
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Post-call recap: pricing, token volumes, and burst / overage terms

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Sara's ask. Quick ask: can we offer a pilot at $11 / 1M (min 10M tokens prepaid) with the following guardrails?

Proposed pilot terms for internal review:
- Pilot length: 3 months; minimum prepaid commitment: 10M tokens at $11 / 1M (prepaid credit applied to usage).
- Burst handling: maintain separate burst bucket of 10M tokens per month that is drawn before overage billing; bursts up to 4x baseline allowed for 30 min windows.
- Overage beyond prepaid + burst bucket: billed at $17.5 / 1M (rounded to $17.50).
- Throttling policy: if a single-minute token rate exceeds the pre-authorized burst window by >20% for 10 consecutive minutes, auto-throttling engages and we notify customer; we will also offer an emergency one-time burst allowance (manual approval).
- PO terms: prefer net30; accept net45 if finance gets a departmental PO; prepay handles the pilot if procurement prefers.

Rationale: $11 pilot still allows margin and gives room to flex to $10 if committed to larger renewals; burst bucket reduces surprise billing while protecting capacity. Would like approval to offer this as a written option.

Please respond if you want changes to overage unit or burst bucket size.

—
Dylan
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Nimbus Analytics Billing <billing@nimbus.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: pricing, token volumes, and burst / overage terms — written option

Sara — thanks for the quick follow. Per internal alignment, here's a written pilot option you can share with procurement: 

Pilot Option A (written):
- Length: 3 months (pilot).
- Prepaid commit: 10,000,000 tokens at $11.00 per 1M tokens (prepay invoice).
- Burst bucket: 10,000,000 tokens / month (separately metered). Bursts consume the burst bucket first; committed baseline is not reduced by burst consumption.
- Burst SLA: allow bursts up to 4x baseline sustained for up to 30 minutes. If traffic exceeds the burst window, the system will automatically throttle traffic to preserve latency SLOs and notify your team. Emergency one-time burst increases can be granted via support channel (manual approval).
- Overage: usage beyond prepaid commit + burst bucket billed at $17.50 per 1M tokens (monthly invoiced).
- PO / Payment: we can accept prepayment for the prepaid commit or standard invoice net30. Finance can accept net45 with a departmental PO; let us know which you prefer.

Attached again: pricing_sheet-v2.pdf (scenarios) and sow-draft-nimbus.docx (pilot statement). If this looks good I’ll send the official SOW + prepay invoice and we can target a kickoff for the week of Aug 17.

If you want us to show a sample monthly invoice with a simulated 3-month launch scenario, we can generate that — just confirm the expected spike shape (CSV).

Thanks — looking forward to getting Nimbus running.

—
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
Attachments: pricing_sheet-v2.pdf, sow-draft-nimbus.docx
